knowledge:
- key_parameters: gem=Gene expression matrix. Must not contain all genes (limit to < ~1000 genes) due to computational limits of correlation matrix calculation ;; seed.size=Size of the initial sample subset to search for (e.g., 10) ;; iterations=Number of iterations to run the seed search algorithm (higher values like 10000 yield more optimal correlation scores) ;; cuts=Number of groups to split genes into using hierarchical clustering ;; splits=Number of groups to split the gene set into to select the best group for correlation vector calculation ;; sort.length=Number of samples to order (useful for partial ordering on large datasets) ;; samp.sig=Numeric value between 0 and 1 determining the proportion of samples in the bicluster
- alternatives: gprofiler (from gProfileR package) can be used as an alternative to the built-in GOEnrichmentAnalysis for gene set enrichment ;; gsva (from GSVA package) for single-sample GSEA (ssGSEA) can be used as an alternative to PointScoreCalc for scoring samples in small datasets or single samples
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing large-scale transcriptomics datasets to identify co-regulated gene sets (biclusters) and order samples based on the strength of these co-regulation patterns
- pitfalls: FindSeed and SampleSort are highly computationally expensive; do not run FindSeed on matrices with > ~1000 genes ;; For large datasets, use sort.length in SampleSort to perform partial ordering, or run on a high-performance computing cluster ;; Since MCbiclust is stochastic, a single run may not find the global optimum; run it multiple times (e.g., 100 runs) and cluster the resulting correlation vectors using SilhouetteClustGroups ;; Ensure the gene expression matrix is transposed (e.g., cor(t(gem))) when calculating gene-gene correlations if genes are rows

workflows.name: single_bicluster_analysis
workflows.intent: Find and analyze a single bicluster from a gene expression matrix using a specific gene set of interest.
input: Mitochondrial_genes (character vector of gene names of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Subset gene expression matrix to the gene set of interest ;; 2. Find a bicluster seed using FindSeed ;; 3. Select highly correlated genes using HclustGenesHiCor ;; 4. Calculate the correlation vector using CVEval ;; 5. Perform gene set enrichment analysis using GOEnrichmentAnalysis ;; 6. Sort samples using SampleSort ;; 7. Calculate PC1 values using PC1VecFun ;; 8. Threshold the bicluster using ThresholdBic and align PC1 using PC1Align ;; 9. Classify samples using ForkClassifier
workflows.code:
mito.loc <- which(row.names(CCLE_small) %in% Mitochondrial_genes)
CCLE.mito <- CCLE_small[mito.loc,]
set.seed(102)
CCLE.seed <- FindSeed(gem = CCLE.mito,
                      seed.size = 10,
                      iterations = 10000,
                      messages = 1000)
CCLE.hicor.genes <- as.numeric(HclustGenesHiCor(CCLE.mito,
                                                CCLE.seed,
                                                cuts = 8))
CCLE.cor.vec <- CVEval(gem.part = CCLE.mito,
                        gem.all = CCLE_small,
                        seed = CCLE.seed, splits = 10)
GSE.MW <- GOEnrichmentAnalysis(gene.names = row.names(CCLE_small),
                               gene.values = CCLE.cor.vec,
                               sig.rate = 0.05)
CCLE.samp.sort <- SampleSort(CCLE.mito[as.numeric(CCLE.hicor.genes),],
                             seed = CCLE.seed)
top.mat <- CCLE.mito[as.numeric(CCLE.hicor.genes),]
pc1.vec <- PC1VecFun(top.gem = top.mat,
                     seed.sort = CCLE.samp.sort, n = 10)
CCLE.bic <- ThresholdBic(cor.vec = CCLE.cor.vec,
                         sort.order = CCLE.samp.sort,
                         pc1 = pc1.vec, samp.sig = 0.05)
pc1.vec <- PC1Align(gem = CCLE_small, pc1 = pc1.vec,
                    sort.order = CCLE.samp.sort,
                    cor.vec = CCLE.cor.vec, bic = CCLE.bic)
fork.status <- ForkClassifier(pc1.vec, samp.num = length(CCLE.bic[[2]]))

workflows.name: multi_run_bicluster_analysis
workflows.intent: Run the stochastic MCbiclust algorithm multiple times to identify multiple distinct correlation patterns and consensus biclusters.
workflows.stages: 1. Run FindSeed multiple times with different random seeds ;; 2. Calculate correlation vectors for each run using CVEval ;; 3. Create a correlation vector matrix ;; 4. Cluster the correlation vectors using SilhouetteClustGroups ;; 5. Calculate average correlation vectors for each cluster ;; 6. Prepare for sorting using MultiSampleSortPrep ;; 7. Sort samples for each cluster using SampleSort ;; 8. Calculate PC1, threshold, and align PC1 for each cluster
workflows.code:
CCLE.multi.seed <- list()
initial.seed1 <- list()

for(i in seq(100)){
  set.seed(i)
  initial.seed1[[i]] <- sample(seq(length = dim(CCLE_small)[2]),10)
  CCLE.multi.seed[[i]] <- FindSeed(gem = CCLE_small[c(501:1000), ],
                                   seed.size = 10,
                                   iterations = 500,
                                   initial.seed = initial.seed1[[i]])
}
CCLE.cor.vec.multi <- list()

for(i in seq(100)){
  CCLE.cor.vec.multi[[i]] <- CVEval(gem.part = CCLE_small[c(501:1000), ],
                                    gem.all = CCLE_small,
                                    seed = CCLE.multi.seed[[i]],
                                    splits = 10)

}
len.a <- length(CCLE.cor.vec.multi[[1]])
len.b <- length(CCLE.cor.vec.multi)
multi.run.cor.vec.mat <- matrix(0,len.a,len.b)
for(i in 1:100){
  multi.run.cor.vec.mat[,i] <- CCLE.cor.vec.multi[[i]]
}
multi.clust.groups <- SilhouetteClustGroups(multi.run.cor.vec.mat,
                                            max.clusters = 20,
                                            plots = TRUE,rand.vec = FALSE)
gene.names <- row.names(CCLE_small)
av.corvec.fun <- function(x) rowMeans(multi.run.cor.vec.mat[,x])
average.corvec <- lapply(X = multi.clust.groups,
                         FUN = av.corvec.fun)
CCLE.samp.multi.sort <- list()
multi.prep <- MultiSampleSortPrep(gem = CCLE_small,
                                  av.corvec = average.corvec,
                                  top.genes.num = 750,
                                  groups = multi.clust.groups,
                                  initial.seeds =  CCLE.multi.seed)
CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[1]] <- SampleSort(gem = multi.prep[[1]][[1]],
                                        seed = multi.prep[[2]][[1]])

CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[2]] <- SampleSort(gem = multi.prep[[1]][[2]],
                                        seed = multi.prep[[2]][[2]])
pc1.vec.multi <- list()
 
pc1.vec.multi[[1]] <- PC1VecFun(top.gem =  multi.prep[[1]][[1]],
                     seed.sort = CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[1]], n = 10)
pc1.vec.multi[[2]] <- PC1VecFun(top.gem =  multi.prep[[1]][[2]],
                     seed.sort = CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[2]], n = 10)
CCLE.bic.multi <- list()
CCLE.bic.multi[[1]] <- ThresholdBic(cor.vec = average.corvec[[1]],
                         sort.order = CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[1]],
                         pc1 = pc1.vec.multi[[1]], samp.sig = 0.05)
CCLE.bic.multi[[2]] <- ThresholdBic(cor.vec = average.corvec[[2]],
                         sort.order = CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[2]],
                         pc1 = pc1.vec.multi[[2]], samp.sig = 0.05)

pc1.vec.multi[[1]] <- PC1Align(gem = CCLE_small, pc1 = pc1.vec.multi[[1]],
                    sort.order = CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[1]],
                    cor.vec = average.corvec[[1]], bic = CCLE.bic.multi[[1]])

pc1.vec.multi[[2]] <- PC1Align(gem = CCLE_small, pc1 = pc1.vec.multi[[2]],
                    sort.order = CCLE.samp.multi.sort[[2]],
                    cor.vec = average.corvec[[2]], bic = CCLE.bic.multi[[2]])

workflows.name: scoring_independent_samples
workflows.intent: Score samples in a dataset based on a known bicluster pattern using PointScore.
input: CCLE.mito (gene expression matrix of the dataset to score)
CCLE.hicor.genes (highly correlated genes from the known bicluster)
CCLE.groups (list of two differently regulated gene groups from the known bicluster)
workflows.stages: 1. Identify the locations of the two differently regulated gene groups ;; 2. Calculate PointScore using PointScoreCalc
workflows.code:
gene.loc1 <- which(row.names(CCLE.mito[CCLE.hicor.genes,]) %in% CCLE.groups[[1]])
gene.loc2 <- which(row.names(CCLE.mito[CCLE.hicor.genes,]) %in% CCLE.groups[[2]])

CCLE.ps <- PointScoreCalc(CCLE.mito[CCLE.hicor.genes,], gene.loc1, gene.loc2)
